subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should per-response `/usage` footers perform a bounded provider-usage lookup during reply delivery, or should quota text wait for cached/preloaded provider usage state?
rationale: Current main lacks the feature and the linked PR is focused, but adding provider/auth probing to a reply-delivery path is a latency and product tradeoff that automation should not decide.

options.title: Accept Bounded Lookup
options.body: Land the linked PR after review or repair if maintainers accept a short timeout and omit-on-failure behavior for usage-enabled replies.

options.title: Require Cached State
options.body: Ask the implementation to source footer quota text from warmed or cached provider usage snapshots before adding it to replies.

options.title: Keep Status Only
options.body: Reject inline quota footers and keep `/status` plus status CLI surfaces as the supported provider quota display.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Lookup
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR after review or repair if maintainers accept a short timeout and omit-on-failure behavior for usage-enabled replies.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied by history and discussion to the provider-usage/status seam and the current scoped product tradeoff.
